verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents a broad first-party connector catalog of 600+ connectors (700+ systems on the marketing site) covering APIs, databases, warehouses and lakes, and a community user describes it handling data from many unusual sources. The evidence does not show that connectors are maintained, and it does not mention file sources, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: evidence of connector maintenance or quality tiers, explicit coverage of file-based sources, and independent hands-on confirmation of catalog breadth for specific SaaS and database systems.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I pick from a broad catalog of maintained connectors for the SaaS APIs, databases, and files my company actually uses

citations.quote: Airbyte provides a catalog of 600+ connectors for APIs, databases, data warehouses, data lakes
Connect 700+ systems to your inference and analytics layers.
Consolidate data from hundreds of sources into your data warehouses, data lakes, and databases.
